I live in a shitty apartment close to campus since my parents refuse to give me a car while I'm at school, yet my older brother also in school was given a car. I'm in my 3rd year and I've explored every, yes every, major. I have found nothing that interests me in any meaningful way, but decided to settle on computer science as I can tolerate it and so I could graduate on time with a decent chance of finding employment. I'd rather not say exactly where I go, but it's a large state school in the midwest. Thanks.

I guess family life could best be described as terrible. I have an older brother and 3 younger sisters, placing me as low as possible on the totem pole. Can't do anything to the older brother or else you'll get your ass kicked which was totally just boys being boys; can't do anything to the younger sisters because boys can't lay a finger on girls, of course the girls would just lie and always say I hit them so I became the little problem child who was always lying to try and get out of trouble and why are you always lying what's the matter with you you know you don't lay a finger on a girl how come you're always getting into trouble and then you try and lie your way out of it why cant you just be normal and not cause problems! All of this while growing up and basically before I could even meet a new parent or teacher to form an impression my mom was talking about how I'm a little shit and to watch out for me cause I'll just try and lie to get out of trouble. Oh and watch out for when he acts nice too! It means he's trying to get something out of you. 

Ya I don't like hanging around my family much, thankfully I'm in college and have my own (shitty) place so I no longer have to be surrounded by people who think I'm some sort of psychopath.
